x_is_bounded_by_p_open.why: a queue joined at 0930 sits behind bid1_vol; it fills only if the queue is drained, which means the limit price was abandoned, which is exactly the h != l (opened) class.  So P(fill) <= P(open) and x = P(V>Q_0930) inherits it.
x_is_bounded_by_p_open.implication: if x is read as a fill probability, it is not 'unmeasured': it is 16/57 with 95% CI [17.0%, 41.5%], and 7% sits outside that interval. If x is read as P(V > Q_0930), it is a mechanistic proxy bounded above by the fill rate.  Either reading makes 42/322 registrations unnecessary.
x_is_bounded_by_p_open.r16_upper_end_excluded: the 50% endpoint of R16's [7%, 50%] is above the 41.5% upper confidence limit of the measured fill rate

x_branch_is_empty.formula_in_r15: EV = p_break * r_break + (1 - p_break) * x * r_locked
x_branch_is_empty.second_term_requires: fill WHILE the board stays locked (h == l all day)
x_branch_is_empty.but_fill_requires: the 0930 queue to be drained -> h != l -> classified in the 16
x_branch_is_empty.note: matches sec 12.16 C's EV(x=0) = 0.2807 * 212.3 = 59.6bp, i.e. the x-term was never separable from the 16; measuring x cannot move it.

tradable_branch_cost.note: this is the branch a fill actually lands in; x's experiments (42/322) never shorten these numbers because they multiply an empty term.

density_band.panel_total_vs_42: the panel contains 41 locked registrations in 367 sessions: the 42-registration experiment cannot be validated inside it
density_band.first_passage_note: max locked cells in any 60-session window is 19, so 42 needs >=3 such windows even at the historical maximum

design_comparison.note: fixed-n needs 42 registrations regardless of the truth; SPRT stops at ~29 if x is really 0.5% and ~25 if it is really 7%.  It fixes the stopping rule only, not the object the registrations measure.

depth_path_code_facts.note: an intraday finalize would (a) select symbols from the last finalized session's enriched cache and (b) write date={enriched_date}, overwriting that session's post-close snapshot; the 15:01-18:00 clamp makes 09:30 unreachable through preferences at all

one_price_composition.note: the 477-per-60-sessions figure counts h == l of any kind; only the limit_up slice is the long-side analogue of the strategy's registrations.

market_wide_fill_branch.reading: the pooled fillable branch is estimable at market scale in weeks; the pool's 16 differ from it only by this t, so the pool's 'edge' on the branch that can actually be filled is a 16-cell claim, not a sample-size problem that 1.5 years of x would fix.
